ra: The Marian-titles hub collects the devotional receptions of the Blessed Virgin Mary (Mary Theotokos).
Our Lady of the Rosary is a devotional title/reception of the Virgin Mary.
Our Lady of Mount Carmel is a title/reception of the Virgin Mary.
The Brown Scapular is a Marian devotion received under the title of Our Lady of Mount Carmel.
Our Lady of Sorrows (Mater Dolorosa) is a devotional title/reception of the Virgin Mary.
Our Lady of Perpetual Help is an icon-title/reception of the Virgin Mary.
The Black Madonna of Częstochowa is a venerated image/reception of the Virgin Mary.
Our Lady of Walsingham is a shrine-title/reception of the Virgin Mary.
Our Lady of Loreto is a Holy-House title/reception of the Virgin Mary.
Our Lady of Mercy (la Merced) is a devotional title/reception of the Virgin Mary.
Our Lady of Akita is an apparition/reception of the Virgin Mary.
Our Lady of Zeitoun is an apparition/reception of the Virgin Mary.

Akita (1973) is a modern approved Marian apparition; wire into the existing Modern Marian Apparitions collective (verified id, same pattern as Fatima/Lourdes).
Zeitoun (1968-71) is a modern mass-witnessed Marian apparition; wire into the existing Modern Marian Apparitions collective (verified id, same pattern as Fatima/Lourdes).
The Brown Scapular is the devotional sacramental associated with the title Our Lady of Mount Carmel.
Our Lady of Mount Carmel is the patronal title of the Carmelite Order, including the Discalced Carmelite reform (verified id).
Devotional tradition (Dominican) ascribes the spread of the Rosary to St Dominic; Our Lady of the Rosary is the Dominican Marian title (verified id).
